CCBox 不设置系统代理或主机 TUN。本机其他代理的 TUN 仍可能影响核心: CCBox does not configure the host system proxy or TUN. Another proxy's TUN mode can still affect outbound connections from the CCBox proxy core. Check the active routes to verify.
CCBox 自带代理核心，无需另外安装 Clash。请先准备你已有的代理订阅或节: CCBox includes a proxy core, so Clash is optional. You will need your own proxy subscription or node details. CCBox does not provide proxy nodes.
仅修改工作台中显示的名称: Changes only the name shown in the workbench
仅允许经节点转发的 IPv4 TCP 和 DNS；公网 UDP、IPv6、ICM: Only IPv4 TCP and DNS forwarded by the selected node are allowed. Public UDP, IPv6, and ICMP remain blocked. Switching nodes closes existing connections and checks the exit again.
仅在你的操作下传递文本: Transfer text only when you initiate it
代理不可用时，CCBox 会停止对外联网。修改表单后需要重新验证。: When the proxy is unavailable, CCBox blocks external network access. Changes must be verified again.
会话列表暂未更新: The session list has not refreshed yet
减少读取项目文件时与本机的往返。在本机上所做的改动最多 20 秒后在环境中可见，: Reduces round trips when reading project files. Host changes may take up to 20 seconds to appear in the environment. Use Refresh project files to sync immediately. Applies on the next environment start.
切换项目只改变新终端和文件编辑器的起始位置；已有终端、网页和登录态会保留。: Switching projects changes the starting folder for new terminals and file editors. Existing terminals, web pages, and sign-ins are preserved.
刷新项目文件：让环境立即看到在本机上所做的改动: Refresh project files so the environment sees host changes immediately
只连接 SSH 主机: Connect to an SSH host only
后台环境仍在运行，任务没有停止: The environment and its tasks are still running in the background
启动后可新建终端: You can open a new terminal after the environment starts
启动或应用设置时更新。多语言地区使用内置默认值；没有建议时保留已选语言。: Updates when you start the environment or apply settings. Multilingual regions use built-in defaults. If there is no recommendation, the selected language is kept.
在 code-server 中打开项目目录: Open the project folder in code-server
在启动或应用设置时重新查询，不会静默重启正在运行的任务。: Checks again when you start the environment or apply settings. Running tasks are never restarted without confirmation.
在设置中恢复环境存储后，再启动浏览器和终端。诊断包可以从同一页面导出。: Restore environment storage in Settings before opening the browser or terminal. You can export a diagnostic bundle from the same page.
填写可信的服务器公钥以核对服务器身份，每行一条；留空时不校验服务器身份。SSH: Enter one trusted server public key per line to verify the server's identity. Leaving this blank skips identity verification. SSH forwards TCP only.
复制粘贴；Ctrl+C 始终用于中断命令。: to copy and paste. Ctrl+C always interrupts commands.
安装包缺少随附代理核心，请重新构建或安装完整 CCBox 应用。: The installer is missing the bundled proxy core. Rebuild or reinstall the complete CCBox application.
客机浏览器暂时无法连接。: Unable to connect to the guest browser.
工作台连接中断，后台状态暂时未知。: The workbench disconnected. The current host status is unknown.
应用端口并重启核心: Apply port and restart proxy core
当前应用启动器需要更新，无法检查快捷登录状态。请重新安装完整的 CCBox 应用: Update the application launcher to check trusted sign-in status. Reinstall the complete CCBox application before changing this setting. Existing authorization is preserved.
当前应用启动器需要更新，暂时无法检查快捷登录状态。请先用密码进入，并重新安装完整: Update the application launcher to check trusted sign-in status. Sign in with your password, then reinstall the complete CCBox application.
当前目录的快捷登录凭据缺失或已失效。请用密码解锁，再到「设置 → 账户 → 登录: Trusted sign-in credentials for this folder are missing or have expired. Unlock with your password, then re-enable them in Settings → Account → Sign-in and unlock.
所有项目共用一个 CCBox 环境: All projects share one CCBox environment
手动更新订阅时通过主机网络下载: Use the host network for manual subscription updates
手动设置时区和语言: Set time zone and language manually
支持 HTTP CONNECT、SOCKS5 和 SSH。填写节点名称、服务器地: Supports HTTP CONNECT, SOCKS5, and SSH. Enter the node name, server address, port, and credentials. For SSH, choose password or private key authentication, then select Import and verify.
支持 YAML / YML / JSON，单个文件不超过 8 MiB: Supports YAML, YML, and JSON. Maximum 8 MiB per file.
时区和语言将使用下方手动选择的值。所有出口仍须查询国家或地区，确认不属于中国大陆: Uses the time zone and language selected below. The exit's country or region must still be checked to confirm it is outside mainland China. This check applies to static IPs and unrestricted regions.
明确打开的项目文件夹会共享到同一个环境。主机的 Claude 登录、SSH 密钥: Project folders you open are shared with the same environment. Host Claude sign-ins, SSH keys, and personal settings are not imported automatically. Browser downloads are kept in a separate staging folder. Use the downloads panel to review them or save them elsewhere.
显示当前核心的连接与流量，包含 CCBox 自身检测请求；重启核心后累计值重置。: Shows connections and traffic for the current proxy core, including CCBox checks. Restarting the core resets the totals.
暂时无法检查系统钥匙串，请先用密码解锁。快捷登录授权记录已保留。: The system keychain is temporarily unavailable. Unlock with your password. Trusted sign-in authorization is preserved.
检测 HTTP 往返延迟，通常不含建连开销，不代表网页首开耗时: Measures HTTP round-trip time, usually excluding connection setup. It does not measure how long a page takes to first load.
检测此节点到 www.gstatic.com 的 HTTP 往返延迟，通常不含建: Measures this node’s HTTP round-trip time to www.gstatic.com, usually excluding connection setup. It does not measure how long a page takes to first load.
正在检查已有配置和安装进度…: Checking saved settings and installation progress…
环境和浏览器可继续使用。: The environment and browser are still available.
环境和终端仍可运行；恢复浏览器不会停止现有终端。: The environment and terminals can continue running. Restoring the browser will keep existing terminals running.
目标网站看到此节点的出口 IP: The exit IP the destination website sees for this node
直接使用一个出口，或经中转连接住宅代理。: Use an exit directly, or connect to a residential proxy through a relay.
粘贴完整 PEM / OpenSSH 私钥内容，不支持填写本机文件路径。: Paste the complete PEM or OpenSSH private key. Local file paths are not supported.
自动更新始终使用当前配置的代理，不会切换到主机下载。: Automatic updates always use the current proxy. They do not switch to the host network.
节点已被移除，请重新选择: This node was removed. Choose another node.
订阅下载失败时，可检查主机是否能访问订阅地址，或改用本地 YAML。节点不可用时: If the subscription download fails, check whether the host can reach the subscription URL or import a local YAML file. If a node is unavailable, choose another and open Diagnostics. The new exit IP and region must still pass verification.
请从 CCBox 应用打开，或在终端运行: Open the CCBox app or run
跟随出口 IP 的时区: Match the exit IP’s time zone
跟随出口地区的语言建议: Suggest a language based on the exit region
这些设置作用于 CCBox 内的系统、CLI 和浏览器。: These settings apply to the operating system, CLI, and browser inside CCBox.
退出账户会撤销本机快捷登录授权。密码始终可以用于解锁。: Signing out revokes trusted sign-in for this device. You can always unlock with your password.
选择“Claude 终端”后，在所选项目中运行此命令，例如 claude --c: Runs this command in the selected project when you open a Claude terminal, for example claude --continue. Leave it blank to use claude. Changes apply to new Claude terminals. The shell remains available after you exit Claude.
选择节点并启用: Select a node and enable it
通过当前节点查询 IP 和位置: Look up the IP and location through the current node
降低浏览器和 Claude Desktop 的清晰度，Linux 环境同时减少: Reduces image quality in the browser and Claude Desktop. On Linux guests it also reduces Claude Desktop animations. Applies on the next environment start.
默认使用 24 小时制。保存后更新工作台底部时钟，无需重启环境；12 小时制使用: The default is a 24-hour clock. Saving updates the workbench clock immediately. A 12-hour clock uses AM and PM.
，按提示登录你的账户。: , then follow the prompts to sign in.
Linux 基础环境启动失败: Could not start the base Linux environment
请查看操作详情，或导出诊断包以确认启动失败的原因。: Open operation details or export a diagnostic bundle to find out why startup failed.
可在原安装目录继续，无需删除已下载的镜像。: You can continue in the original installation folder and keep the downloaded image.
下载、安装、必要授权和检查都在这里完成。中断后可以继续原任务。: Download, install, grant permissions, and run checks here. If setup is interrupted, you can resume the same task.
Linux 客机未报告初始化完成: the Linux guest did not report that initialization finished
虚拟机后台在环境就绪前退出: the virtual machine process exited before the environment was ready
无法读取虚拟机后台的启动状态: the virtual machine startup state could not be read
等待虚拟机就绪超时: the wait for the virtual machine to become ready timed out
启动 Linux 基础环境失败：虚拟机未能启动。QEMU 启动失败：{0}。请查: The virtual machine could not start: {0}. Open operation details or export a diagnostic bundle for more information.
请打开“操作详情”查看启动记录。若继续安装仍失败，可从安装页底部的“日志与诊断”: Open Operation details for the startup log. If the retry fails, export a diagnostic bundle from Logs and diagnostics at the bottom of the setup page.
Claude Code 等待确认: Claude Code is waiting for approval
终端有操作等待确认，点击返回终端: A terminal action needs approval. Open the terminal to respond.
本轮回复已结束，点击返回终端: The response is complete. Open the terminal to view it.
可手动继续安装，已保存的下载会尝试续传。: You can continue the installation. CCBox will try to resume saved downloads.
为 CCBox 准备独立环境: Set up an isolated environment for CCBox
环境已启动，等待联网检查: Environment started, waiting for network checks
安装并检查客机环境: Install and check the guest environment
请确认客机的存储位置。: Confirm the storage location for the guest.
客机内的浏览器和开发工具共用此代理。: The browser and developer tools in the guest share this proxy.
系统、开发组件和网络检查均已完成，可以进入工作台开始使用。: Setup and network checks are complete. Open the workbench to get started.
独立客机已安装，工具、文件和登录状态会持续保存。以后打开 CCBox 可直接进入: The isolated guest is installed. Tools, files, and sign-ins are saved. The next time you open CCBox, it will go directly to the workbench.
当前代理出口被检测为中国大陆，CCBox 外网保持关闭。更换并应用符合要求的代理: The proxy exit is in mainland China, so external network access stays closed. Apply an eligible proxy node to resume the installation.
安装进度、已下载文件和虚拟磁盘会保留。你可以在此界面继续安装。: Progress, downloaded files, and virtual disks will be kept. You can resume the installation here.
正在确认环境已就绪…: Confirming that the environment is ready…
系统镜像、下载缓存和虚拟磁盘保存在这里。已填入默认目录，也可以选择其他本地磁盘上: System images, cached downloads, and virtual disks are stored here. Use the suggested folder or choose an empty folder dedicated to CCBox on another local drive.
这是 CCBox 的环境数据目录。更新、重装或卸载应用会保留这里的数据；请勿手动: CCBox stores environment data here. Updating, reinstalling, or uninstalling the app preserves these files. Keep this folder.
请输入存储目录的完整路径: Enter the full path to the storage folder
已有虚拟磁盘，继续使用原存储目录。完成初始化后可在设置中迁移。: CCBox found an existing virtual disk and will keep using its original folder. You can move it from Settings after setup.
系统镜像通过主机网络下载，遵循主机系统代理或 TUN 设置，不使用 CCBox: System images download through the host network and follow its system proxy or TUN settings. If you use Clash or a similar app, enable its system proxy or TUN first. Its rules determine how the image host is reached.
新订阅链接（留空保留）: New subscription URL (leave blank to keep the current one)
有未应用的代理修改: Proxy changes have not been applied
选择完成后应用代理: Apply the proxy after choosing a node
输入客服提供的重置码，为线上账户设置新密码。: Enter the reset code from support to set a new online account password.
输入客服提供的重置码。本机加密资料仍需使用原密码解锁。: Enter the reset code from support. Your original password is still needed to unlock encrypted files on this device.
使用已注册的 CCBox 账户登录这台电脑，密码同时用于解锁这台电脑上的数据。: Sign in with your CCBox account. Your password also unlocks your data on this computer.
注册后可在其他电脑登录同一账户。密码同时用于解锁这台电脑上的数据。: After registering, you can sign in with the same account on other computers. Your password also unlocks local data on this device.
在云端创建账户，保护这台主机上的工作与登录状态。: Create a cloud account to protect your work and sign-ins on this host.
先注册用户名和密码，再选择客机系统并安装环境。macOS 客机会使用同一套账密。: Create a username and password, then choose and install the guest system. macOS guests use the same credentials.
3–32 个字母、数字、下划线、连字符或点。: Use 3–32 letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens, or periods.
信任此电脑，下次用当前系统用户打开时直接进入。: Trust this computer to skip sign-in next time you open CCBox as the current system user.
已有 CCBox 账户？登录: Already have a CCBox account? Sign in
账户资料保存在当前云端主机: Account data stays on the current cloud host
本机数据只保存在这台设备上，CCBox 服务器只保存账户与授权: Local data stays on this device. CCBox servers store only account and license information.
账户资料仅保存在这台设备上: Account data stays on this device
退出应用，后台继续运行: Quit the app and keep background tasks running
此设备尚未激活: This device has not been activated
激活码兑换到线上账户 {0}，{1}；该账户登录的其他电脑同样可用。: The code applies to the online account {0}: {1}. It also applies to other computers signed in with this account.
在当前到期时间后增加 30 天: add 30 days to the current expiry date
提前续期会在当前到期时间后增加 30 天。: Renewing early adds 30 days to your current expiry date.
输入激活码，为此设备开通 30 天。: Enter an activation code to activate this device for 30 days.
换机所需的设备编号: Device ID for transferring to a new computer
当前构建无需激活。: This build does not require activation.
